title: Qualifications.
officialText:
Safety Compliance Officers shall have experience in supervising the construction operations being
monitored. They shall be an architect or engineer who has experience supervising construction projects in New York City, a licensed
site safety manager or coordinator or other licensee of the department, or a special inspector as provided for in article 115 of this title.
Safety Compliance Officers shall carry insurance as required by the department.
